fields.description: Issue includes editorial commentary on a Dade County grand jury investigation and allegations involving Miami public officials, including discussion of bribery and courthouse testimony. Features an open letter addressed to Postmaster General James A. Farley concerning his stay at the Miami Biltmore Hotel and its associations. Contains local columns and notices ("Sparks of Life," "Round the Town," "They Tell Me"), a piece explaining the Federal Housing Administration/National Housing Act housing program, and extensive nightlife, entertainment, and racing-related content and advertising (including Hialeah track tips and Miami Beach venues).
